_doc: Spell id -> the Forever wiki row (key = the row's item link, skill = its Skill cell) for a recipe whose wiki row names the same item differently: a wiki typo or disambiguator, or a Classic item name the game has since changed. Each alias is backed by DB2 facts of build 1.60.1.71037: the teaching item's RequiredSkillRank equals the row's skill, or the created item id carries the row's name in the Vanilla build 1.15.8.67156. Not used to choose between an old and a revised spell; that is left to an in-game capture.
